classification: static exact-artifact disassembly, correlated separately with virtual-device input

observations.detail: Immediate 15 selects live input register; read proceeds without interrupt-status predicate
Input byte bit1 is extracted; bit0 masked at 0x4202a948; both buttons have state paths
A hold elapsed greater than 999 causes event value 10 at 0x4202a9d2
A release clears held state; short-release event value 28 emitted at 0x4202aa74
B long event numeric value 27; B short release event numeric value 29 at 0x4202aac4
Normal return value is 60; failure return is 100 at 0x4202a8c8

source_comparison.difference: Public fork polls status 0x13 and bit0 only, whereas this original artifact directly polls live input 0x0F and tracks both bits; its hypothesized release fault must not be attributed to this BIN
